description: Read one chat, oldest to newest: the latest messages, or older ones with before (wazap asks the phone when the local history runs out). Long texts are cut unless full_text. chat_id "status" reads the stories people posted, newest first, from the last hours (at most a day); they show nowhere else.

chat_id.description: Chat id from another tool, a phone number, or "status" for stories

full_text.description: Each message's text whole; a list cuts long ones otherwise

hours.description: "status" only: how far back, 24 by default

include_previews.description: Attach a small image of each photo, up to 12

types.description: Only these types; limit counts them, so ["call"] gives that many calls

name: read_messages

notes.description: Caveats to act on or tell the user

older.description: before ran past the local history: the phone was asked, and sent this many

omitted.description: Older stories left out by limit

unconfirmed_sends.description: Sends WhatsApp has not echoed yet: outcome unknown, not failed

title: Read messages from a WhatsApp chat
